review.purpose: Validate the DeepSeek dub repair on exactly ten existing SRT entries, not ten long sentence groups.
review.precision: bfloat16 with the existing FasterQwen runtime on T4; no alternative GPU/model; x-vector clone of an 8-second source reference.
review.reason: Run the repaired production dub.py and fitter remotely, preserving the first cue and reporting all actual durations at max_speed 1.0.
review.input: First ten entries of CRISPR-120s.nemo.de.srt, original times 4.320-33.799 s, shifted to zero. Exactly 29.479 s of original video and an 8-second reference. Existing German wording unchanged. Smoke first two entries, then all ten; shared exact-text raw cache can reuse the smoke audio. No ASR, translation, adaptation, demucs, optional burn-in, other model or full-length video.
review.outputs: New isolated deepseek_t4_10cues_2026-11-05/smoke and workload directories with raw/fitted audio, full fit report, logs and metadata. A dubbed MP4 is included only if every cue fits at 1.0x. A completed measurement with fit failures is explicitly needs_review, not a successful dub.
review.quality_tradeoffs: SRT entries can be sentence fragments; the tenth entry ends mid-sentence. This test intentionally preserves exactly ten cue texts and timings, disables merging, and tests timing only. No guarantee of naturalness or preserved translation meaning. Fitting failures do not trigger retries or text rewriting. Clone failure stops; no fallback model.
review.cost_estimate: At https://modal.com/pricing checked 2026-11-05: T4 $0.000164/s, CPU $0.0000131/core/s, RAM $0.00000222/GiB/s. Two stages capped at 300 s each, 4 CPU and 24 GiB => $0.161808 compute estimate; approximately $0.17 including short teardown. Image-build, storage and transfer costs are additional and not exactly known; this is not a provider-enforced dollar cap. Each result <=128 MiB. No automatic retries.
